title: packera dimorphophylla subsp. intermedia
intro: Packera dimorphophylla subsp. intermedia, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Indian paintbrush or Intermediate American paintbrush, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Packera dimorphophylla subsp. intermedia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
